users.bio: Computer Science student passionate about web development.
HR coordinator at a local NGO.
Design student exploring UX and graphic design.

opportunities.title: Software Engineering Intern
opportunities.description: Join our engineering team for a 3-month internship. You'll work on real-world projects, collaborate with senior engineers, and gain hands-on experience with modern web technologies. We're looking for passionate individuals who are eager to learn and contribute to meaningful projects.
opportunities.requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field. Basic knowledge of JavaScript, React, and Node.js. Strong problem-solving skills.
opportunities.benefits: Mentorship from senior engineers, flexible working hours, networking opportunities, potential full-time offer upon completion.

opportunities.title: Full Stack Developer
opportunities.description: We're looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our growing team. You'll be responsible for building and maintaining web applications, designing APIs, and mentoring junior developers.
opportunities.requirements: 3+ years experience with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Experience with cloud services (AWS/GCP). Strong communication skills.
opportunities.benefits: Remote work option, health insurance, annual bonus, professional development budget.

opportunities.title: Chetra Scholarship Program 2025
opportunities.description: The Chetra Scholarship Program provides full tuition coverage for outstanding Cambodian students pursuing higher education in STEM fields. Recipients also receive a monthly stipend and mentorship opportunities.
opportunities.requirements: Cambodian citizen. High school diploma with GPA 3.5+. Demonstrated financial need. Strong academic record in math and science.
opportunities.benefits: Full tuition coverage, monthly stipend of $300, mentorship program, networking events with industry leaders.

opportunities.title: Beach Cleanup Volunteer Day
opportunities.description: Join us for a day of community action! We'll be cleaning up Sihanoukville beach, sorting recyclables, and educating locals about ocean conservation. All materials and refreshments provided.
opportunities.requirements: No experience needed. Must be 16+. Comfortable working outdoors in tropical heat. Bring water and sunscreen.
opportunities.benefits: Free t-shirt, lunch provided, certificate of participation, meet like-minded people.

opportunities.title: Hackathon: Code for Good
opportunities.description: A 48-hour hackathon where teams build tech solutions for social impact projects. Win prizes, meet mentors, and launch your ideas. All skill levels welcome.
opportunities.requirements: Teams of 2-4 people. Bring your own laptop. Basic programming knowledge helpful but not required.
opportunities.benefits: Prizes for top 3 teams ($1000, $500, $250), mentorship from industry experts, food and drinks provided, networking opportunity.

opportunities.title: Marketing Intern
opportunities.description: Learn the ropes of digital marketing in a fast-paced agency environment. You'll assist with social media management, content creation, campaign analytics, and client communication.
opportunities.requirements: Current student or recent graduate in Marketing, Communications, or related field. Familiarity with social media platforms. Good writing skills.
opportunities.benefits: Hands-on experience, portfolio building, flexible schedule, potential full-time role.

opportunities.title: ASEAN Youth Leadership Scholarship
opportunities.description: Full scholarship for ASEAN students to pursue undergraduate studies in regional development, public policy, or international relations. Includes tuition, accommodation, and travel allowance.
opportunities.requirements: ASEAN citizen. Age 17-22. Strong academic record (GPA 3.0+). Demonstrated leadership experience. Proficiency in English.
opportunities.benefits: Full tuition, accommodation, monthly stipend ($500), round-trip airfare once per year, internship placement.

opportunities.title: UX Research Volunteer
opportunities.description: Help us improve our product by conducting user research sessions! We need volunteers to participate in usability testing, interviews, and surveys. Your feedback shapes our features.
opportunities.requirements: Must be 18+. No prior UX experience needed. Comfortable sharing honest feedback. 1-2 hour commitment per session.
opportunities.benefits: Gift vouchers for participation, early access to new features, certificate of participation.

opportunities.title: National Debate Championship
opportunities.description: Annual national debate competition for university students. Compete against teams from across Cambodia on pressing social and economic issues. Semi-finals and finals are broadcast on national TV.
opportunities.requirements: Enrolled in a Cambodian university. Team of 3 members. Proficiency in Khmer and English. Prior debate experience preferred but not required.
opportunities.benefits: Cash prizes for winners ($2000, $1000, $500), trophy, certificates, TV exposure.

opportunities.title: Junior Data Analyst
opportunities.description: Analyze data to drive business decisions. You'll work with large datasets, create dashboards, and present insights to stakeholders. Great opportunity for recent graduates.
opportunities.requirements: Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science or related field. Proficiency in SQL and Python. Experience with Tableau or Power BI is a plus.
opportunities.benefits: Health insurance, 13th month salary, annual training budget, growth opportunities.

opportunities.title: Graphic Design Volunteer
opportunities.description: Design promotional materials for our community programs. Create posters, social media graphics, and brochures that communicate our mission visually.
opportunities.requirements: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite or Canva. Portfolio of design work. Good communication skills. 5+ hours per week commitment.
opportunities.benefits: Portfolio-worthy work, certificate of appreciation, letter of recommendation for outstanding volunteers.

opportunities.title: Business Plan Competition 2025
opportunities.description: Pitch your startup idea to a panel of investors and industry experts. Finalists receive seed funding, mentorship, and incubation support. Previous winners have raised over $100K.
opportunities.requirements: Cambodian citizen or resident. Age 18-35. Registered or aspiring entrepreneur. Business plan must address a Cambodian market need.
opportunities.benefits: Seed funding up to $10,000, 6-month incubation program, mentorship from successful entrepreneurs, networking events.

opportunities.title: Healthcare Assistant Internship
opportunities.description: Shadow healthcare professionals and assist with patient care, administrative tasks, and health education programs. Ideal for pre-med or nursing students.
opportunities.requirements: Enrolled in a medical, nursing, or public health program. Basic first aid certification preferred. Compassionate and professional demeanor.
opportunities.benefits: Clinical experience, mentorship from doctors, certificate of completion, reference letter.

opportunities.title: Data Science Fellowship
opportunities.description: A 6-month intensive fellowship program covering machine learning, statistical analysis, and data engineering. Fellows work on real client projects and receive a stipend.
opportunities.requirements: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field. Programming experience in Python or R. Strong analytical and communication skills.
opportunities.benefits: Monthly stipend of $500, hands-on project experience, industry mentorship, job placement assistance.

opportunities.title: Environmental Research Assistant
opportunities.description: Conduct field research on marine ecosystems, document biodiversity, and contribute to conservation reports. Work with international researchers and local communities.
opportunities.requirements: Degree in Environmental Science, Marine Biology, or related field. Field research experience. Scuba diving certification preferred. Khmer language required.
opportunities.benefits: Field allowance, accommodation provided, research publication credits, networking with international scientists.

opportunities.title: Photography Exhibition: Urban Stories
opportunities.description: Submit your best photographs capturing urban life in Cambodia. Selected works will be exhibited at a month-long gallery show in Phnom Penh. Categories include Street, Portrait, Architecture, and Daily Life.
opportunities.requirements: Open to all Cambodian and international photographers. Submit up to 5 high-resolution images per category. Brief artist statement required.
opportunities.benefits: Gallery exhibition, cash prizes ($500, $300, $200), publication in art catalog, feature on our website and social media.

applications.cover_letter: I am a passionate CS student eager to contribute to TechStars' mission...
As a high-achieving student with a strong background in math and science...
I love building things that make a difference...
